source.branch: When hero-caused wall or door damage has a live damage-list cost and an in-shop keeper, pay_for_damage chooses the nearest affected keeper, performs source-ordered movement and payment/hostility behavior, and may request payment; this case reaches zap_dig’s shopwall tail and the keeper relocation/payment path.
dependencies: Existing js/shk.js:shop_keeper, inhishop, money2mon, check_credit, home_shk, pacify_shk, hot_pursuit, and cad implementations are direct dependencies.
Existing js/mon.js:mnexto and mnearto provide shopkeeper relocation.
shk.c:getcad is called with its result discarded; where its behavior is not ported, retain the explicit note_unported gap and skip it.

Caller ownership dependencies: B-investigation-v53-earth-remote-blessed-pick-cave-action10-20261012 owns dig.c:dig; A2-investigation-v53-barefoot-kick-cockatrice-corpse-action1-20261012 owns dokick.c:really_kick_object.

evidence: The admitted v53 evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-0ddbafd22e56dbc0365fbc0355c9dac9352cba43-v53.json records 266/295 screens, 4555/4617 RNG calls, and 292/295 cursors matched for this case, with error null and 29 screens remaining.

The immutable v53 manifest sourceTrace for this case states the input breaks an ordinary main-room ring-shop wall with a charged digging wand; C follows zap.c:dozap to dig.c:zap_dig, bills 200 zorkmids through shk.c:pay_for_damage, and moves Gheel beside the damaged wall. The first screen divergence is at step 266.

C source nethack-c/upstream/src/dig.c:1548-1759 accumulates shopwall damage and calls pay_for_damage(shopdoor ? "destroy" : "dig into", FALSE) after the digging loop. nethack-c/upstream/src/shk.c:5174-5358 implements keeper selection, movement, billing and response. The call is absent in js/zap.js:6089-6318, which currently records note_unported('shk.c pay_for_damage').

Direct callers were enumerated with rg -n "pay_for_damage\(" nethack-c/upstream/src/{apply,explode,zap,dig,hack,dokick}.c. Their JS gaps were found with rg -n "pay_for_damage" js/{apply,explode,zap,dig,hack,dokick}.js. B owns the separate dig.c:dig caller; A2 owns dokick.c:really_kick_object. Neither reservation overlaps the selected zap_dig caller or shk.c callee.
